title: Hey-Ho, Nobody's Home
transcription:
Hey-Ho,
Nobody's Home

Hey-Ho, nobody's home
Eat nor drink nor money have I none
Still I will be merry,
Soul cake, Soul cake,
an apple, a plum, a cherry,
anything to make us merry.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from a clear two-page scan. Some small instructional text and dialect spellings may need verification.
